summary.headline: Nykaa Q2 FY27 net revenue rose 28% YoY to INR 3,006 crores, with EBITDA up 65% to INR 263 crores at an 8.7% margin.
summary.overview: Q2 FY27 GMV was INR 6,151 crores (+30% YoY) and PAT was INR 101 crores (+207% YoY, 3.4% margin), with EBITDA margin expanding 196 bps to 8.7%. Beauty NSV grew 28% and crossed a 10% EBITDA margin for the first time; Fashion NSV grew 47% and reached EBITDA breakeven (INR 1 crore). Management highlighted House of Nykaa growth, the Simply Nam acquisition (82% stake for INR 33 crores), a L'Oreal partnership, Nykaa Now quick commerce scaling, and ROCE of 27.3%. Management said the festive season has shifted into Q3, so Q3 is not yet judged.

financial_highlights.change: +207% YoY (PAT margin vs 1.4% a year ago)
vs INR 178 crores (~9%) a year ago; +51% YoY
vs minus INR 12 crores (-3.5%) a year ago

segments.name: Beauty
segments.commentary: Q2 GMV above INR 4,400 crores (+25% YoY); NSV INR 2,500-plus crores (+28%); EBITDA +51% YoY and first crossing of 10% margin (10.5%). H1 NSV INR 4,907 crores (+29%).

segments.name: Fashion
segments.commentary: Q2 NSV INR 509 crores (+47% YoY) on GMV growth of 42%; EBITDA INR 1 crore (0.2% margin), third consecutive profitable quarter. H1 NSV INR 960 crores (+50%). Marketing cost down ~350 bps YoY; overheads down from 13% to 11.1% of revenue.

segments.name: House of Nykaa
segments.commentary: Annualised GMV run rate INR 4,000 crores and annualised NSV INR 2,300 crores; Q2 NSV INR 535 crores (+39% YoY). Dot & Key annualised NSV INR 1,300 crores; Kay Beauty INR 350 crores run rate; Nykaa Cosmetics about INR 300 crores.

segments.name: Superstore (B2B)
segments.commentary: Scale up ~28% on NSV; onboarded retailers grew 27% to over 0.5 million across 1,200 cities; offline BDE headcount flat at 2,300; GMV per BDE up 14%. Marketing and S&D expense improved 363 bps.

guidance_outlook: Long-term fashion EBITDA guidance unchanged: high single digits by FY30 and 10%-plus in steady state; management declined to give 3-4 quarter guidance and said FY30 is 'not next year for sure'.
Beauty to reach about 600 stores over the next few years (338 today).
Festive season shifted into Q3; Nykaa's big sale typically late November. Management declined to guide on Q3 until full-quarter numbers are available.
Simply Nam acquisition expected to close in Q3 FY27, subject to regulatory approvals.
Capex to remain steady at about 1% of revenue.
capex_capacity: Capex about 1% of revenue, steady, directed to retail store expansion, fulfillment and tech.
Beauty stores at 338 (253 multi-brand, 69 House of Nykaa, 16 brand boutiques; 14 added in Q2); presence in 111 cities.
Nykaa Now quick commerce expected to be live in about 25 cities by year-end (per analyst question; not contradicted by management).
Fixed asset turnover 10.8x in H1 FY27 vs 9.9x in FY26; working capital days stable at 28 days.
Capital employed INR 2,566 crores vs INR 1,786 crores in Q2 FY24.
demand_pricing: Beauty AOV up 5% YoY on premiumisation; management said growth is premiumisation-led rather than price inflation.
Beauty monthly active unique visitors +30%; annual unique transacting customers 22.1 million; Beauty retail like-for-like growth above 20%, the highest in six quarters.
Fashion AOV close to INR 4,400; new customers +31% YoY with customer acquisition cost down 30%; cumulative fashion customers above 12 million; visits +25%.
Superstore NSV growth constrained deliberately for efficiency; GST-led gap between GMV and NSV narrows from Q3 as the base laps.
Over 45 brands on the Nykaa Global Store growing over 60% YoY; 330-plus beauty and 1,700-plus fashion brands launched in the last year; 17 global luxury brands in the Global Store.

qa_highlights.question: How does Nykaa view AI-driven brand proliferation and AI shopping agents bypassing its platform?
qa_highlights.answer: Falguni Nayar said agents will not optimise only for one outcome and cited Nykaa's moats in assortment, delivery speed and advice; she said beauty brand proliferation is good for retailers, and personalisation and a customer data cube are in progress.

qa_highlights.question: What are Nykaa Now's unit economics versus the core platform?
qa_highlights.answer: Anchit Nayar said standalone financials are not disclosed; cost of servicing is not materially different from a mainline order, and AOV may be slightly lower but frequency is higher.

qa_highlights.question: What drove 20%-plus Beauty like-for-like growth, and how much is pricing? How much did H&M and Nike contribute to Fashion's customer acquisition?
qa_highlights.answer: Falguni Nayar attributed Beauty growth to new customer acquisition, AOV premiumisation and retention, and said pricing inflation is not the driver. In Fashion, footwear and men's categories grew strongly; no quantification of the H&M or Nike contribution was given.

qa_highlights.question: Where are ad revenues as a percentage of GMV, and is there a ceiling?
qa_highlights.answer: Ad revenue as a percentage of GMV is not disclosed; management said margins tend to be much higher than standard retail and that the ad platform is still building, with no ceiling in view.

qa_highlights.question: Why guide to FY30 for fashion margins rather than sooner?
qa_highlights.answer: Abhijeet Dabas reiterated the long-term guidance and declined shorter guidance; Falguni Nayar said repeat customer build-up takes time and the main improvement lever is marketing.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a festive slowdown in e-commerce, and why did operating cash flow turn negative in H1?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to guide on Q3 festive trends. P. Ganesh said negative operating cash flow reflects festive inventory build-up, which should normalise by quarter-end.

qa_highlights.question: Is the Beauty marketplace frequency of purchase trending down, and will order-volume KPIs continue to be disclosed?
qa_highlights.answer: Anchit Nayar said frequency of purchase is a weighted average affected by new-customer mix, and that management tracks cohorts separately; he deferred disclosure questions to the IR team.

risks_watch: Q3 festive season performance, as management declined to guide and noted the Nykaa big sale is late November.
Competition from quick commerce expansion into smaller cities, with Nykaa Now at about 25 cities; possible frequency-of-purchase softness on the Beauty marketplace as flagged by an analyst.
Dependence on Fashion's marketing efficiency and brand partnerships (H&M, Nike) for margin progress.
Negative H1 operating cash flow attributed to inventory build; watch normalisation by Q3 end.
Discontinued disclosure of marketplace order volume KPIs; IR team to confirm.
Simply Nam closing, subject to regulatory approvals, in Q3.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on Beauty margins, Fashion breakeven and ROCE, but cautious and non-committal on Q3 festive trends and on shorter-term margin timing, which management kept tied to the FY30 target.
key_quotes: So clearly, the first half has been reasonably strong, with the second quarter being slightly improved compared to the first quarter.
So overall, very strong quarter and looking forward to quarter 3.
We never share 2, 3 quarters out guidance.
